title: Cathode Gauze in the original Last Train palette
implementationNotes: Keep the interface edge-to-edge, dark, sparse, and card-free.
Use service blue for ordinary trains, last-train red only for the final departure, and white for primary labels.
Make departure time the dominant information and preserve the gauze and ghost-numeral depth treatment.
Carry the same visual language through Fast Train, sheets, widgets, Lock Screen, and Dynamic Island.
